name: list_streams
description: External evidence streams opened with --open-pcap: format, interfaces with link types and loss counters (ISB ifdrop/osdrop, epb_dropcount, truncated records), file stop state (complete/truncated/corrupt/limit with byte offset), undecoded count, flows, declared clock (pcap times are CLOCK_REALTIME) and its mapping to the --open-capture archive's CLOCK_MONOTONIC with uncertainty, or unaligned. Read-only; no live capture.

name: query_stream
description: Page through a stream's records: time and clock, interface, captured/original length, raw byte reference, decoded summary (Ethernet/VLAN/SLL/IPv4/IPv6/TCP/UDP/ICMP) or the typed reason it is undecoded, and flow_id. Filters: time range (clock 'stream' = file realtime ns since the epoch; 'capture' = ns since the capture start, aligned records only), flow_id, interface, protocol, port, undecoded. Continue with start=next.

flows.description: Also return the flow table page (flow_id, 5-tuple, packets, bytes).

include_raw.description: Hex of the first 256 captured bytes per record. Refused (RawPayloadRedacted) when xodb runs with --redact.

start.description: Record index to resume scanning from.

name: correlate
description: Join one record to the socket and process that held its 5-tuple, from the socket tables the capture archive recorded at capture start and stop. basis: exact (protocol and both endpoints equal a connected socket held by the process, packet time within the sampled window), sampled (same match, time outside the window or stream unaligned), inferred (local endpoint only: listening/unconnected socket), none. Thread attribution is not available from socket tables and is reported as null with the reason.
